title: Asthma severity and cystic fibrosis
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's asthma or cystic fibrosis (only that code).
note:
Chief Complaint
Shortness of breath and wheezing.

HPI
The patient is a 36-year-old woman presenting for an evaluation of her severe persistent asthma. She reports a significant exacerbation that began earlier this week. She describes increased difficulty breathing, a productive cough, and audible wheezing at rest. She has attempted to manage these symptoms with her maintenance inhaler, but she reports that her symptoms have not improved. She denies any fever or chills.

Medication List
1. Fluticasone/Salmeterol inhaler
2. Albuterol and ipratropium bromide nebulizer

Exam
The patient appears in mild respiratory distress. Oxygen saturation is 94% on room air. Auscultation reveals bilateral expiratory wheezing throughout all lung fields. No accessory muscle use is noted at this time.

Assessment
1. Severe persistent asthma with an acute exacerbation.

Plan
The patient will begin a course of a prednisone burst to manage the acute exacerbation. She was instructed to use her rescue inhaler every 4 hours as needed for symptoms. She will follow up in one week for a reassessment of her respiratory status.

Electronically signed, L. Moreau, DO, 10/14/2026
explanations: Severe persistent asthma with (acute) exacerbation: J45.51 (HCC 279).
